text: Chapter 3 of the Municipal Code requires that the “Auditor General shall undergo an external peer review once every three years to ensure compliance with government auditing standards” and furthermore, “the results of the external peer review shall be reported to Council through the Audit Committee”. Compliance with Government Auditing Standards is an important component of audit quality and is critical in maintaining credibility with City Council, management and the taxpaying public. The external peer review will result in significant benefits to both the Auditor General’s Office and the City.
